summary: Iteration 2 (auth + extended fields + CSV export + delete-all safeguard) fully tested. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed - JWT login, /auth/me, admin-only register, self-delete guard, brute-force lockout (429 observed), unauth 401 on /api/instances /stats /terraform, CRUD with all new fields persists (environment, ec2_instance_id, vpc, subnet, AZ, private/public_ip, security_groups[], ebs_volumes[], iam_instance_profile, tags{}, custom_metadata{}), CSV import safeguards (non-.csv 400, >5MB 413), CSV export with all columns & semicolon-joined lists, delete-all requires confirm=DELETE_ALL (400 without), Terraform HCL includes private_ip/availability_zone/iam_instance_profile/vpc_security_group_ids/ebs_block_device/merged Environment+AWS tags+custom metadata, JSON valid. Frontend: Login page redirects to dashboard on success and shows error on wrong creds; protected routes redirect to /login when logged out; Sidebar shows user info + Sign out working; Inventory add-instance dialog exposes all 21 grouped extended fields and creates successfully; Export CSV downloads infra_inventory.csv; Delete-all shows confirm dialog; Team page - admin can add + delete member; Terraform generator with checkboxes generates HCL/JSON. Seed CSV re-imported after cleanup (5 hosts, 54 DNS, 4 SRV).

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is per (client_ip, email). Behind the ingress load-balancer, requests can be distributed across backend replicas so exact 'lockout after 5 attempts' is not guaranteed from a single external caller. Lockout was observed within 8 attempts. Consider keying only by email (or by X-Forwarded-For) so the 5-attempt threshold is honored regardless of replica.

issues: Radix DialogContent used without a DialogDescription or aria-describedby - accessibility warning in console

action_items: (Optional) Key brute-force counter by email only (or normalized proxy IP) so 5-attempt lockout is deterministic behind LB
(Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Add Instance, Add Team Member, Delete confirm dialogs to silence a11y warnings

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event handlers (FastAPI recommends lifespan)
CORS allow_origins hardcodes 'http://localhost:3000' in addition to FRONTEND_URL - fine for dev but should be documented
auth.py brute-force key is `ip:email` - with multiple backend replicas or shared proxy IPs the effective count-per-user across replicas is diluted, weakening the intended 5-attempt guard

InstanceForm silently swallows the API error detail on save failure (generic 'Save failed') - would be better to surface backend detail as elsewhere
